newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: French state's CLF stake placed - ABN AMRO.
newsitem.headline: French state's CLF stake placed - ABN AMRO.

text.p: The French government's 7.5 percent stake in Credit Local de France has been placed with institutional investors at a price of 440 francs per share, ABN AMRO Rothschild said.
ABN AMRO Rothschild, part of Dutch bank ABN AMRO Holding NV's securities business, was sole manager and bookrunner for the offering of 2.765 million shares.
It said the offer price to institutional investors around the world represented a 1.2 percent discount to the September 25 closing price for Credit Local shares on the Paris bourse.
The shares were evenly distributed in France, Britain, other European countries and to a lesser extent in the United States, ABN AMRO Rothschild said.
ABN AMRO Rothschild is an equity capital markets joint venture formed in May between the Dutch bank and the Rothschild group of unlisted, family-owned merchant banks.
